record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.original_question: For Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces of the unit disk with radial symbols, the paper discusses boundedness, compactness, and Fredholmness on A^2. Extend those radial-symbol results from the Hilbert Bergman space A^2 to the more general Bergman spaces A^p with 1 < p < ∞.

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Generalize the results on boundedness, compactness and Fredholmness of Toeplitz operators on A2 with radial symbols to other Bergman spaces Ap.

artifact.status_search_result: Partial extensions of radial-symbol Toeplitz theory to A^p (1<p<∞) exist (e.g., boundedness/compactness via Berezin transform for BMO₁ symbols, weighted sup-norm spaces, and distributional symbols), but a complete characterization of boundedness, compactness, and Fredholmness for arbitrary radial symbols on all A^p analogous to the A^2 theory does not appear to be fully established in the literature retrieved. Status remains unclear.

status_evidence.title: On the boundedness of Toeplitz operators with radial symbols over weighted sup-norm spaces of holomorphic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies boundedness of Toeplitz operators with radial symbols on weighted spaces of holomorphic functions, extending A^2 results to other settings.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists for radial-symbol Toeplitz operators outside A^2.

status_evidence.title: Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Boundedness and compactness of T_a on Bergman spaces A^p for 1<p<∞ allowing distributional symbols.
status_evidence.claim: Some A^p extensions for radial/distributional symbols are available.

status_evidence.title: Toeplitz operators in Bergman space induced by radial measures
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work (2025) on radial-measure-induced Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Research on radial-symbol Toeplitz operators on Bergman spaces is ongoing.
